summary: MediAssist — Patient Symptom Triage Chatbot — conversational ai chatbot with clinical decision support.
requirement_text:
Organisation: Apollo Hospitals
Segment: Healthcare — Patient Engagement

AI SUGGESTED & EDITED PARAMETERS:
TOOLS AND TECH STACKS: Node.js, TensorFlow, React Native, AWS, MongoDB, API integration for real-time appointment scheduling
KNOWLEDGE BASE SOURCES: Clinical guidelines, Patient FAQs, Hospital treatment protocols, Evidence-based research articles
SUPPORTED LANGUAGES: English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu
PERSONA AND TONE: Empathetic, professional, reassuring, culturally sensitive
FALLBACK MECHANISMS: Escalation to human clinician, emergency service dial-out, automated responses for common inquiries
EXPECTED OUTCOME: 40% reduction in call center volume, patient satisfaction score above 4.2 out of 5, zero clinical safety incidents attributable to chatbot advice
REGULATORY CONSTRAINTS: HIPAA compliance, No diagnostic claims, Emergency routing for life-threatening symptoms, adherence to local healthcare regulations
USER ACCESS CHANNELS: Mobile application, Website interface
